# Vision and Senses

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md)*

Light, obscured areas and special senses.

## Entries

- [Blindsight](Blindsight.md): If you have Blindsight, you can see within a specific range without relying on physical sight.
- [Bright Light](Bright-Light.md): Bright Light is normal illumination.
- [Darkness](Darkness.md): An area of Darkness is Heavily Obscured.
- [Darkvision](Darkvision.md): If you have Darkvision, you can see in Dim Light within a specified range as if it were Bright Light and in Darkness within that range as if it were Dim Light.
- [Dim Light](Dim-Light.md): An area with Dim Light is Lightly Obscured.
- [Heavily Obscured](Heavily-Obscured.md): You have the Blinded condition while trying to see something in a Heavily Obscured space.
- [Lightly Obscured](Lightly-Obscured.md): You have Disadvantage on Wisdom ( Perception ) checks to see something in a Lightly Obscured space.
- [Telepathy](Telepathy.md): Telepathy is a magical ability that allows a creature to communicate mentally with another creature within a specified range.
- [Tremorsense](Tremorsense.md): A creature with Tremorsense can pinpoint the location of creatures and moving objects within a specific range, provided that the creature with Tremorsense and anything it is detecting are both in c...
- [Truesight](Truesight.md): If you have Truesight, your vision is enhanced within a specified range.
